title: Railway RRB ALP & Technician Master Guide: CBT Stages, Trade Syllabus, CBAT & Free Study Kit
summary: Complete preparation roadmap for Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) and Railway Technician: CBT-1 & CBT-2 patterns, Basic Science & Engineering syllabus, CBAT psycho batteries, A-1 medical eye standards, running allowance salary, and free mock test portals.
author: Sarkari Aavedan Editorial Team
content:
## Introduction & Career Overview

The Railway Recruitment Boards (**RRB**) recruit tens of thousands of technical professionals across 21 railway zones for the positions of **Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP)** and **Technicians (Grade I Signal & Grade III Trades)**. As frontline running staff, ALPs co-pilot electric and diesel locomotives hauling high-speed passenger expresses, Vande Bharat rakes, and heavy freight rakes. Benefiting from substantial kilometer-based running allowances, ALPs enjoy exceptional monthly earnings, high job security, and accelerated promotional paths to Senior Loco Pilot and Loco Inspector.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> For the post of **Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP)**, final merit is calculated with **70% weightage to CBT-2 Part A** and **30% weightage to the Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT / Psycho Test)**. In addition, candidates must clear **Part B Trade Test with minimum 35% marks**!

## RRB ALP & Technician Posts & Pay Scales (7th CPC)

| Post Name & Department | Educational Qualification | 7th CPC Pay Level | Entry Basic Pay | Approx Starting Monthly Salary (Including Running Allowance) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) - Mechanical / Electrical** | 10th + ITI in relevant trade OR 3-year Diploma in Engineering OR B.E. / B.Tech | **Level-2** | ₹19,900 – ₹63,200 | **₹45,000 – ₹60,000 / month** (Includes Running Kilometre Allowance of ~₹4.50 to ₹6.00/km) |
| **Technician Grade-I Signal** | B.Sc in Physics/Electronics/CS OR 3-year Diploma / B.Tech in Engineering | **Level-5** | ₹29,200 – ₹92,300 | ₹48,000 – ₹54,000 / month |
| **Technician Grade-III (Electrician, Fitter, Welder, Machinist)** | 10th + ITI in designated trade OR 10+2 with Physics and Maths | **Level-2** | ₹19,900 – ₹63,200 | ₹32,000 – ₹36,000 / month |

## Step-by-Step Selection Procedure for ALP

1. Register online on the central Railway Recruitment Board portal (rrbapply.gov.in).
2. Appear for CBT-1 (1st Stage Computer Based Screening Test) — 75 questions in 60 minutes (Qualifying in nature).
3. Shortlisted candidates (15 times vacancies) appear for CBT-2 consisting of Part A (100 Qs merit stage) and Part B (75 Qs trade qualifying stage).
4. Candidates qualifying both Part A and Part B (with min 35% in trade) are called for CBAT (Computer Based Aptitude Test / Psycho Test) in an 8:1 ratio.
5. Shortlisted candidates undergo biometric Document Verification (DV) based on 70% CBT-2 Part A + 30% CBAT composite score.
6. Pass the strict Railway A-1 Medical Fitness Examination at Railway Divisional Hospitals before appointment.

## CBT-1 Examination Pattern & Weightage Graph

CBT-1 is a 60-minute objective online screening test with 75 questions for 75 marks. There is **1/3rd negative marking** for every incorrect response.

| Subject / Section | Questions | Marks | Mark Weightage Graph | Core High-Yield Topics |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Mental Ability (Reasoning)** | 25 Questions | 25 Marks | [BAR:33.3%:Reasoning] | Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding-Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Blood Relations, Syllogisms |
| **Mathematics** | 20 Questions | 20 Marks | [BAR:26.7%:Mathematics] | Number System, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM/HCF, Ratio, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Speed & Distance |
| **General Science** | 20 Questions | 20 Marks | [BAR:26.7%:General Science] | High school level Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (Focus on Mechanics, Electricity, Light, Acids/Bases, Human Body) |
| **General Awareness on Current Affairs** | 10 Questions | 10 Marks | [BAR:13.3%:Current Affairs] | Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Indian Railway Developments |
| **Grand Total (CBT-1)** | **75 Questions** | **75 Marks** | **[BAR:100%:Total Composite]** | **Composite Time: 60 Minutes (Qualifying: UR-40%, OBC/SC-30%, ST-25%)** |

## CBT-2 Examination Scheme (The Merit Deciding Stage)

CBT-2 is conducted in two parts in a continuous 2 hour 30 minute session.

| CBT-2 Part | Content & Subject Structure | Questions & Marks | Timing | Merit Status & Evaluation Rules |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Part A (Merit Deciding)** | Mathematics (25 Qs), General Intelligence & Reasoning (25 Qs), Basic Science & Engineering (40 Qs), Current Affairs (10 Qs) | **100 Questions (100 Marks)** | 90 Minutes | **70% weightage** in final ALP merit ranking; **100% weightage** for Technicians. 1/3rd negative marking. |
| **Part B (Trade Qualifying)** | Technical Trade Theory as per DGT syllabus (Electrician, Fitter, Wireman, Diesel Mechanic, Electronics, Turner, etc.) | **75 Questions (75 Marks)** | 60 Minutes | **Mandatory 35% Qualifying Marks (26.25 marks)** for all categories (No relaxation for SC/ST). If you fail Part B, Part A is rejected! |

> [!TIP]  
> **Basic Science & Engineering carries 40 Marks in Part A**: This dedicated section tests Engineering Drawing (projections, views, drawing instruments, lines), Units & Dimensions, Work Power & Energy, Speed & Velocity, Heat & Temperature, Basic Electricity, Levers & Simple Machines, Occupational Safety, and IT Literacy.

## Mandatory A-1 Medical Standard (The Strict Eye Test)

> [!WARNING]  
> Assistant Loco Pilots operate trains at speeds exceeding 130 km/h. Indian Railways enforces the strictest **A-1 Medical Classification**:  
> - **Distant Vision**: 6/6, 6/6 without glasses (NO glasses or contact lenses allowed).  
> - **Near Vision**: Sn: 0.6, 0.6 without glasses.  
> - **Surgical Correction Disqualification**: Any candidate who has undergone **LASIK, PRK, or laser eye surgery is permanently disqualified** upon medical scanning.  
> - **Color Vision**: Must pass Ishihara test for lantern, mesopic vision, and color blindness.

## Day-by-Day 60-Day Study Strategy

- **Weeks 1 to 4**: Master CBT-1 Math & Reasoning basics. Simultaneously spend 1 hour daily on Bharat Skills ITI trade question banks to ensure your 35% pass mark in CBT-2 Part B is secure.
- **Weeks 5 to 6**: Dive deep into **Basic Science & Engineering (40 marks)**. Memorize levers (first, second, and third order), simple machines mechanical advantage formulas, and basic circuit series/parallel calculations.
- **Weeks 7 to 8**: Complete full 75-question mock tests every morning under a 60-minute timer. Practice eye exercises to maintain peak vision fitness.
